buildSurface.statement: The adapter is one complete Cargo build surface. Qualification must not pass undeclared synthetic feature names.

currentCapabilities: pinned-CA HTTPS read of one exact KV-v2 string field
independently signed final-use grant and operator approval
closed consumer registry bound to an immutable configuration digest
explicit Claimed Reserved DispatchFenced durable consumption saga
operation-ID reservation lookup and restart reconciliation without blind redispatch
immutable provider-failure and proved consumer-NotApplied terminal evidence
metadata-only receipts and secret-buffer best-effort zeroization
bounded single-writer JSON reference owner with fsync and fencing
proof-preserving schema-3 to schema-4 migration for durable consumption history
single-sourced durable phase recovery-action and future-capacity classification
secret-free state recovery capacity and commit-cost diagnostics
bounded full-forward and recovery latency/error-class metrics
redacted Debug surfaces for secret paths and secret-related digests
transactional SQLite metadata-owner source with revision CAS, append-only transitions, reconciliation claims, terminal archive and checkpoint hashing
SQLite product-runtime source with atomic forward execution leases, bounded recovery claims and secret-free metrics
schema-4 JSON reference-owner import into the SQLite owner with an immutable import receipt
targetOnlyCapabilities: selected Agentd or App Server production bootstrap
independently operated trusted-time settlement and key-rotation services
external anti-rollback checkpoint service and disaster-recovery ceremony
target-host power-loss and long-history archival qualification
selected-host metrics export alerting and retention policy
independent operator acceptance promotion and release
exact-head and deterministic-merge qualification of the SQLite owner/runtime source

recoveryStates.meaning: operation identity and exact semantics are durable; no reservation is implied
recoveryStates.recovery: atomically seal absent AuthBus admission for the exact operation/effect or bind the returned original reservation; a SELECT absence is not proof

recoveryStates.meaning: the original AuthBus reservation is durable; dispatch has not been fenced
recoveryStates.recovery: query the reservation; cancel or expire Held reservations and record a terminal pre-dispatch abort

recoveryStates.meaning: AuthBus committed mark_dispatch_attempted; provider or consumer outcome may be unknown
recoveryStates.recovery: never redispatch; reconcile provider/consumer evidence and the original reservation

recoveryStates.meaning: validated metadata receipt is durable before final authority recheck; consumer entry is not proved
recoveryStates.recovery: query the original registered observer; accept only Succeeded or evidence-bound NotApplied

recoveryStates.meaning: dispatch or consumer entry may have occurred but terminal effect is not proved
recoveryStates.recovery: query the original observer and AuthBus reservation; do not fetch the secret or call the consumer

recoveryStates.meaning: consumer success and receipt digest are durable; settlement or local final commit may remain
recoveryStates.recovery: settle the original reservation idempotently and commit Succeeded

recoveryStates.meaning: the original observer supplied immutable negative evidence
recoveryStates.recovery: settle the original reservation as Rejected with zero observed cost and commit Failed

recoveryStates.meaning: a deterministic provider error and terminal evidence are durable
recoveryStates.recovery: settle the original reservation with the recorded charging policy and commit Failed

recoveryStates.meaning: consumer success and AuthBus settlement are both recorded
an immutable terminal negative outcome and its settlement/abort proof are recorded

recoveryStates.recovery: look up and bind the original reservation, then migrate to Reserved or DispatchFenced without redispatch
